items.source: as of 6.0.12 since JTA 1.1+ requires implicit rollback-only setting in case of an exception thrown in beforeCompletion, so the regular SpringJtaSynchronizationAdapter(TransactionSynchronization) constructor is sufficient for all scenarios
items.translation: 自 6.0.12 版本起，由于 JTA 1.1+ 要求在 `beforeCompletion` 中抛出异常时设置隐式的 rollback-only，因此常规的SpringJtaSynchronizationAdapter(TransactionSynchronization)构造函数已足以应对所有场景。

items.source:
Create a new SpringJtaSynchronizationAdapter for the given Spring
TransactionSynchronization and JTA TransactionManager.
items.translation: 为给定的 Spring `TransactionSynchronization` 和 JTA `TransactionManager` 创建一个新的 `SpringJtaSynchronizationAdapter`。

items.source: springSynchronization - the Spring TransactionSynchronization to delegate to
Needs to invoke the Spring synchronization's beforeCompletion at this late stage in case of a rollback, since there is no corresponding callback with JTA.
items.translation: 需要在回滚时在此较晚的阶段调用 Spring 同步的 `beforeCompletion`，因为 JTA 没有相应的回调。

items.source:
Useful for synchronizing Spring resource management code with plain
JTA / EJB CMT transactions, despite the original code being built for
Spring transaction synchronization.
items.translation: 适用于将构建于 Spring 事务同步的原生代码与纯 JTA/EJB CMT 事务进行同步，尽管原始代码是专为 Spring 事务同步而构建的。

items.source: In case of an exception, the JTA transaction will be marked as rollback-only.
items.translation: 如果出现异常，JTA 事务将被标记为仅回滚。

items.source: jtaUserTransaction - the JTA UserTransaction to use for rollback-only setting in case of an exception thrown in beforeCompletion
items.translation: jtaUserTransaction - 在 beforeCompletion 中抛出异常时，用于设置回滚仅模式的 JTA UserTransaction。

items.source: jtaTransactionManager - the JTA TransactionManager to use for rollback-only setting in case of an exception thrown in beforeCompletion
items.translation: jtaTransactionManager - 在 beforeCompletion 中抛出异常时，用于设置回滚仅模式的 JTA TransactionManager。
JTA afterCompletion 回调：在提交/回滚后调用。

items.source: JTA beforeCompletion callback: just invoked before commit.
items.translation: JTA beforeCompletion 回调：仅在提交前调用。
